portfolio_commentary: The Scheme had 3 additions and 6 deletions this month as we booked profits and redeployed them into names where results were strong but price action anemic.
The Scheme is overweight on consumer discretionary and industrials with an underweight on energy, pharma and materials sectors.
We are reasonably confident about our portfolio holding on its own going ahead. Small caps underperformance is becoming an opportunity for a value investor.
portfolio_positioning: We may add weights to smaller names in the portfolio where we see a valuation bottom and turnaround in sentiment.
We are also looking at special situations and turnaround as a theme in this Scheme.
We see GDP in H2 to bounce back as macros improve.
We are expecting markets to get more broad-based driven by earnings growth upgrades and the positioning of the Scheme will be kept with that fact in mind.
